findings.title: Stale diagram renders after Mermaid disabled mid-flight
findings.problem: generateDiagram() checks isMermaidAvailable only before firing the request; after workflowsStore.getWorkflowDiagram resolves it unconditionally calls setSchemaImage(json.data), and the image block (lines 345-355) renders schemaImage whenever it is set with no isMermaidAvailable guard and no effect that clears it when the flag flips to disabled.
findings.impact: If the Visualize request starts during the not-yet-fetched window (defaults to available per spec) or the flag flips to disabled while a request is in flight, the component ends up showing both the rendered diagram image and the 'Diagram rendering is not configured.' InfoBox simultaneously, contradicting the required 'preview is disabled/hidden with a hint' behavior.
findings.recommendation: Re-check isMermaidAvailable before calling setSchemaImage (or bail out of the .then branch), and add a useEffect that clears schemaImage when isMermaidAvailable becomes false; alternatively gate the image-render block itself on isMermaidAvailable.

fix.change: generateDiagram now re-checks a live isMermaidAvailableRef after the async response resolves before calling setSchemaImage, and a useEffect clears/revokes schemaImage whenever isMermaidAvailable flips to false, so a diagram that resolves after the flag disables is discarded instead of rendered.
fix.test: npx vitest run --project unit src/pages/workflows/components/__tests__/WorkflowFormFields.test.tsx (new case: "discards a diagram that resolves after Mermaid flips to unavailable mid-flight (regression)")
